name: Hans Crowbar
source:
Second violin of the rival quartet. Hans is a close friend of [url=/c4038]Phill[/url] and an outstanding student. Generally a rather plain and mundane individual - some would even say a nerd - but his passion for classical music can only be described as fanatical.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064244/www.elizar.com/?p=23]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
